title: Terminal and Orbit
author: Jude Quintana
blurb: Orsen Villalobos, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
